audit_metadata.title: Independent Readiness Review & Environment Sealing
audit_metadata.working_tree_status: DIRTY_CONTROLLED_AUDIT (Audit tests, Docker definitions, gate module, and reports added; zero production code or models modified)

candidate_model_designation.architecture: Tabular-Only XGBoost with Isotonic Probability Calibration

exclusion_of_late_fusion.rationale: Late Fusion calibrator artifact was omitted from serialization in Stage 3.4. Tabular-only model represents the approved candidate for general order-level fraud ranking and exhibits bit-for-bit reproducibility.

candidate_model_designation.synthetic_data_disclaimer: All performance metrics are derived from synthetic data benchmarks and do not prove performance on real-world marketplace distributions.

container_and_environment_reproducibilit.docker_engine_error: failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine: The system cannot find the file specified.
container_and_environment_reproducibilit.container_digest_blocker: Docker Desktop daemon is not running on the local Windows host. Image build could not complete during this turn. Dockerfile and exact lockfile created; image must be compiled on a host with active daemon prior to holdout unblinding.

model_loading_warnings.host_warning: InconsistentVersionWarning: Trying to unpickle estimator IsotonicRegression from version 1.9.0 when using version 1.9.1.
model_loading_warnings.remediation: Lockfile pins scikit-learn==1.9.0 exactly to match model serialization version and eliminate unpickling warning.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Authorization is required before holdout generation
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: v2.2 generator does not exist in repository; generation requires separate script creation upon authorization.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Authorization is required before label decryption
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: No encrypted holdout labels or decryption scripts exist yet; protocol defined in evaluator checklist.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Developer cannot obtain decryption key through evaluation interface
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: Key custody assigned exclusively to Independent Auditor; key never committed to repository.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Evaluation process fails closed when authorization is absent
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: trustshield_project/evaluation_gate.py::verify_holdout_authorization raises PermissionError fail-closed; verified by test_stage351_environment_sealing.py.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Prediction artifacts bound to approved model, source revision, input manifest, and environment digest
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: trustshield_project/evaluation_gate.py::create_prediction_commitment generates cryptographic commitment binding all four elements.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Prediction IDs and counts are validated before scoring
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: trustshield_project/evaluation_gate.py::validate_prediction_contract enforces exact row counts, sequence match, and non-null values.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Missing, duplicate, or unexpected predictions cause execution to abort
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: validate_prediction_contract raises ValueError immediately on duplicates, drops, reordering, NaN, or Inf.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Evaluation code and metric implementations are versioned and hashed
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: Metric code in utils.py, calibration.py, and test suites are tracked in Git with verified SHA-256.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: System cannot silently repeat holdout evaluation to facilitate iterative tuning
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: trustshield_project/evaluation_gate.py::enforce_single_shot_evaluation maintains persistent ledger and raises RuntimeError on duplicate run ID.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Logs do not expose protected labels or secrets
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: Evaluation gate and test scripts log only aggregate confusion matrices and hashes; zero row-level label dumps.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Generator cannot be run accidentally through readiness workflow
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: Generator scripts are strictly isolated with main blocks; test suites never invoke generators.

security_controls_actual_code_audit.description: Unauthorized attempts leave an auditable record where supported
security_controls_actual_code_audit.evidence: verify_holdout_authorization writes structured JSONL audit logs with timestamps and failure reasons.

unconstrained_minimum_cost.operational_assessment: Unusable in production without capacity constraints; reviewing 43% of transactions would overwhelm operations.

capacity_constrained_policy.tie_breaking: Conservative thresholding (volume <= C); deterministic ordering by (score DESC, order_date ASC, order_id ASC)

remaining_blockers.title: OCI Container Image Digest Build & Pinning
remaining_blockers.action_required: Start Docker daemon on build host, execute 'docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.evaluator -t trustshield-evaluator:pinned .', extract immutable @sha256:... digest, and verify smoke test inside container.

remaining_blockers.title: Holdout v2.2 Authorization & Key Escrow
remaining_blockers.action_required: Sign off on Stage 3.5.1 Independent Evaluator Checklist, generate CSPRNG seed, and authorize generation and encryption of v2.2 holdout.
